# Shintaine Ruiz Tajanlangit

> Product Designer & Creative Developer based in Cebu, Philippines. I'm a product designer who codes. For nine years I've helped founders in health, climate and hospitality turn fuzzy ideas into calm, useful products.

- Email: shintainet@gmail.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/shintayyyn
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/shintayyyn/
- Services: Product design (UX/UI); Brand systems & identity; Design systems; Interactive prototypes; Front-end development; Motion design

## Projects
- [Fieldnote](https://itsshintayyyn.vercel.app/project-fieldnote.html): A calm, offline‑first journaling app for field researchers. (Lead Product Designer, Research tools, 2026)
- [Lumen Health](https://itsshintayyyn.vercel.app/project-lumen-health.html): Rebranding a telehealth platform to feel less clinical, more human. (Design Lead, Health-tech, 2025)
- [Kettle & Co](https://itsshintayyyn.vercel.app/project-kettle-co.html): Identity and ordering experience for a neighbourhood tea house. (Brand & Web Designer, Hospitality, 2025)
- [Orbit Labs](https://itsshintayyyn.vercel.app/project-orbit-labs.html): A data visualisation toolkit and dashboard for climate scientists. (Product Designer & Front‑end, Climate science, 2024)
- [Parcel](https://itsshintayyyn.vercel.app/project-parcel.html): Shipping dashboard redesign for small online sellers. (Senior Product Designer, Logistics, 2024)
- [Monograph](https://itsshintayyyn.vercel.app/project-monograph.html): Type‑led identity and website for an independent architecture press. (Designer, Publishing, 2023)
- [Tandem](https://itsshintayyyn.vercel.app/project-tandem.html): A shared-budget app for couples and housemates. (Product Designer, Fintech, 2023)
